## Suggest a demo

Found a concrete Astra project worth including? Open an issue using the demo suggestion template. Please include the original creator’s post, what was built, and any live demo or code link. Prompts alone, unsupported performance claims and duplicate reposts are not enough. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Credits & corrections

All projects and third-party previews belong to their respective creators. Links are provided for discovery, not as a claim of ownership or permission to reuse their work. If an attribution, link or description needs correcting—or you want an entry removed—please open an issue.
